create.name: iYoga – Iyengar Yoga Centrum Antwerpen
create.bio:
iYoga is the Iyengar Yoga Centrum of Antwerp, opened in 2002 by Ann Brosens in the Zuid district. The studio is a 60-square-metre room hidden behind the houses of Verschansingstraat, in what was once part of the city's horse stables, and its brick walls and quiet make it a calm refuge from the busy streets outside.

Ann came to yoga by an unusual road. She trained as a musician at the Lemmens Institute in Leuven and taught classical guitar at the city's conservatory for around ten years, then met the Iyengar method in 1995 during a sabbatical at Gangotri, near the source of the Ganges. She retrained in Amsterdam, Cologne and Pune, holds the Level 3 certificate and still teaches daily. She works with a team that includes Ilythyia De Ligniere, a former dancer and choreographer who has taught here since 2010 and co-founded the non-profit Praan with Ann, along with several other certified teachers.

The timetable offers general classes of 60 to 120 minutes, pranayama, graded Level 1, 2 and 3 sessions and a monthly theme class, most of them streamed live as well as taught in the studio. A first basic or general class is free.

courses.title: Iyengar yoga classes in Antwerp and live online
courses.description: A weekly timetable of general classes from 60 to 120 minutes, pranayama, and graded Level 1, 2 and 3 sessions, most taught hybrid: in the studio and streamed live at the same time. The first basic or general class is free; booking is through Momoyoga.

courses.title: Christmas workshop with Ann Brosens
courses.description: A two-hour Sunday morning workshop with the centre's founder, one of the special sessions the studio adds alongside its monthly theme classes and graded Level 1–3 sessions.
courses.price: 30€ via losse les / 27€ via 5 x 120min / 23€ via 10 x 120min / Opleidingskaart
